intro.zh: 今天这批项目透露出一个明显信号：围绕编码 agent 的控制层和交互协议正在快速成型，同时轻量化本地基础设施（容器运行时、小模型训练、Docker 管理面板）重新受到关注。开发者不再满足于单个 agent 能力，而是想把它接入自己的工作流和设备，这为做中间层和垂直场景的人留出了空间。
intro.en: Today's batch points to a shift: the control plane and interaction layer around coding agents is solidifying fast, while lightweight local infrastructure, from container runtimes to tiny model training, is getting renewed attention.

zh.summary: T3 Code 是编码 agent 的开源控制平面，agent 跑在你自己的机器上，桌面、网页、手机都能接管同一个会话，支持 Claude Code、Codex 等多家 agent。它不转售 token，直接驱动你已订阅的账号。
zh.insight: 机会在「多 agent 编排 + 移动端审批」这个缝隙：面向重度使用多个编码 agent 的个人开发者，先做会话交接和权限审批的体验，而不是再做一个 agent。

en.summary: T3 Code is an open control plane for coding agents: they run on your machine while desktop, web, and phone share one session.
en.insight: The opening is multi-agent orchestration with mobile approval. Target developers juggling several coding agents and nail session handoff and permission review,

items.description: The best way to control Claude Code, Codex and more from any computer or phone

zh.summary: AG-UI 是一个事件驱动的开放协议，把 agent 的流式输出、工具调用、状态更新、人工介入统一成一条双向事件流，让任意框架的 agent 都能接入任意前端。1.0 版本刚发布。
zh.insight: 适合作为基础设施押注：做 agent 前端组件库或调试工具，切「同一 agent 多端渲染」的场景，比各家自己写胶水代码省事得多。

en.summary: AG-UI is an open event-based protocol that standardizes streaming tokens, tool calls, state updates, and human handoffs into one bidirectional stream,
en.insight: A solid infrastructure bet: build agent frontend components or debugging tools around rendering one agent across many clients,

items.description: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: MiniMind 用约 3 元成本和 2 小时在单张 3090 上从零训练一个 64M 小模型，并开源了预训练、SFT、LoRA、RLHF、Agentic RL 等全链路 PyTorch 原生代码，同时扩展到视觉和多模态。
zh.insight: 它的价值是教学与实验底座：可以做面向高校或转行者的付费实验课，或基于它做特定领域的极小模型微调服务，卖的是可复现而不是算力。

en.summary: MiniMind trains a 64M model from scratch in about two hours on one 3090 for roughly three yuan, open-sourcing the full PyTorch pipeline from pretraining to RLHF and agentic RL,
en.insight: Its value is as a teaching and experiment base: run paid hands-on courses for students and career switchers,

items.description: 🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: vllm-ascend 是社区维护的 vLLM 华为昇腾硬件插件，让 vLLM 的推理服务能跑在昇腾 NPU 上，已发布多个正式版本并保持周会节奏。对受限于 GPU 供应的团队是现实选项。
zh.insight: 这是基础设施信号而非创业点子：围绕昇腾做模型适配、性能调优和迁移咨询，服务那些拿不到英伟达卡但要做推理部署的企业。

en.summary: vllm-ascend is a community-maintained hardware plugin bringing vLLM inference serving to Huawei Ascend NPUs, with regular releases and a weekly SIG.
en.insight: More an infrastructure signal than a startup idea: offer Ascend model porting, tuning, and migration consulting to enterprises that need inference but cannot…

items.description: Community maintained hardware plugin for vLLM on Huawei Ascend
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: Arcane 是面向普通用户的现代 Docker 管理面板，用 Go 和 SvelteKit 写成，可自托管，覆盖容器和 Compose 的日常操作。v3 正在主分支开发，社区功能请求已迁到 Discussions。
zh.insight: 自托管面板的差异点在「给非运维的人用」：面向家庭服务器或小团队，把备份、更新、告警做成向导式流程，而不是再堆一层仪表盘。

en.summary: Arcane is a modern, self-hosted Docker management UI written in Go and SvelteKit, covering everyday container and Compose operations.
en.insight: Differentiate a self-hosted panel by serving non-operators: for home labs or small teams, turn backups, updates,

items.description: Modern Docker Management, Designed for Everyone

zh.summary: Ghost Downloader 3 是一个跨平台下载器，支持 HTTP3、BT、FTP，用异步架构和 Fluent Design 界面，主打把多种下载协议收进一个工具。适合需要批量或跨区域下载的个人用户。
zh.insight: 下载器的机会在「带策略的批量抓取」：面向做数据采集或内容归档的小团队，把代理轮换、断点续传和任务编排做成可编程接口。

en.summary: Ghost Downloader 3 is a cross-platform downloader covering HTTP3, BitTorrent, and FTP with an async architecture and Fluent Design UI,
en.insight: The opening is policy-driven batch fetching: for small teams doing data collection or archiving, expose proxy rotation, resumable transfers,

items.description: The only downloader you need. 下载器的集大成者。

zh.summary: Univer 把表格、文档、幻灯片等办公编辑能力做成可嵌入的 SDK，开源核心可扩展，并提供了让应用和 agent 操作可编辑内容的 Facade 接口。适合想把办公套件塞进自己产品的团队。
zh.insight: 切入点是把「AI 可编辑的表格」嵌进垂直 SaaS，比如财务或供应链工具，让 agent 直接改单元格而不是输出文本，差异化在可撤销的协作编辑。

en.summary: Univer packages spreadsheet, docs, and slide editing as an embeddable SDK with an extensible open core and a Facade API so apps and agents can edit content directly.
en.insight: Embed AI-editable sheets into vertical SaaS like finance or supply chain, letting agents change cells rather than emit text.

items.description: Build your own AI office with Univer Office SDK. Bring editing, calculation, collaboration, and file processing into your product for people and AI agents. Built on an extensible open-source core.

zh.summary: Kiri 是用 Rust 写的轻量容器运行时，兼容 Docker CLI、Compose 和 buildx，在 macOS、Windows、Linux 上跑单个小虚拟机，定位是 Docker Desktop 和 OrbStack 的替代品，还带一个免费的 Ngrok 替代。
zh.insight: 适合做开发者本地环境的周边生意：围绕它做镜像缓存、团队共享配置或内网穿透的托管服务，切「不想为 Docker Desktop 付费」的中小团队。

en.summary: Kiri is a Rust container runtime compatible with Docker CLI, Compose, and buildx, running in one small VM on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.insight: Build around local dev environments: image caching, team-shared configs, or hosted tunneling on top of it,

items.description: A small, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux with free Ngrok alternative

zh.summary: 一个 agent skill，跨 Reddit、X、YouTube、HN、Polymarket 抓取某个话题近 30 天的讨论，再按点赞和真实资金排序合成摘要。零配置，可装进 Claude Code 等 50 多个 agent 宿主。
zh.insight: 可以借它的「按真实信号排序」思路做垂直情报产品：面向投资或选品的人，把社区热度与预测市场赔率结合成可订阅的周报。

en.summary: An agent skill that pulls the last 30 days of discussion on any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, and Polymarket, then ranks and synthesizes by likes and real money.
en.insight: Borrow the real-signal ranking idea for vertical intelligence: for investors or product scouts, combine community heat with prediction-market odds into a…

items.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary

zh.summary: GestaltX 是一个 iOS 的 MobileGestalt 编辑器，可调整区域代码、灵动岛、常亮显示、充电限制等设备预设，并支持备份。面向喜欢折腾 iPhone 和 iPad 的高级用户。
zh.insight: 这类工具本身难产品化，但反映了越狱后市场对「安全回滚」的需求：可以做配置备份、变更对比和恢复的一站式服务，降低折腾门槛。

en.summary: GestaltX is a MobileGestalt editor for iOS that tweaks region codes, Dynamic Island, always-on display, charge limits, and other device presets, with backups.
en.insight: Hard to productize directly, but it signals demand for safe rollback in the jailbreak-adjacent market: offer config backup, diff,

items.description: An MobileGestalt editor for iOS 27.x, featuring region-code tweaks, device presets, backups.
